tasks.brief: A team wants a local guard that catches CI workflows which look complete but would never test anything
tasks.task: Write a PowerShell 5.1 checker for a GitHub Actions workflow file that proves the test step is real, not just present
acceptance: Rejects a workflow whose test command is commented out, disabled with 'if: false', or only echoed
Treats event names and action references as case-sensitive: 'Push' and 'actions/Checkout@V4' are rejected
Flags unknown or misspelled job and step keys such as 'whit:' or 'timeout-minute:'
Ships a -SelfTest switch with at least 6 broken sample workflows, each named after the single check it should trip
Uses only built-in PowerShell 5.1 cmdlets and .NET classes; no modules to install
